use_cases: Landing page entry point with engaging animated text reveal
Portfolio or personal website hero section
Product launch or marketing page header
ai_summary: A modern animated hero section featuring a custom TextScramble effect that reveals text character-by-character with randomized symbols transitioning into final words. Built with React hooks and a TextScramble class using requestAnimationFrame for smooth 60fps animation. Functions as a visually engaging landing page header suitable for SaaS products, portfolios, or marketing campaigns.
